newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium sets 4% 2000 OLO line for April 21 auction.
newsitem.headline: Belgium sets 4% 2000 OLO line for April 21 auction.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury said on Monday it was setting a new line of four percent January 2000 linear government bonds (OLOs) for its April 21 auction.
It would also be inviting tenders for 6-1/4 percent 2007 OLOs BE286= at that auction. The ISIN code for this paper, the current 10-year benchmark, is BE0000286923.
Payment on the issues is due on April 24.
